connectionSpecification.description: Reads queryable Salesforce objects through SOQL with a connected app's OAuth refresh token.

api_usage_threshold_percent.description: Share of the org's daily API request allocation, 1 to 100 percent, at which a read saves its state and stops.
api_usage_threshold_percent.title: API Usage Threshold

client_id.description: Consumer key of the connected app.
client_id.title: Client ID

client_secret.description: Consumer secret of the connected app.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

instance_url.description: https URL of the org, as the token response's instance_url gives it.
instance_url.title: Instance URL

is_sandbox.description: The org is a sandbox: tokens come from test.salesforce.com instead of login.salesforce.com.
is_sandbox.title: Sandbox

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token of the connected app for the integration user. Use a connected app whose refresh token policy is "valid until revoked", so the token does not rotate.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

start_date.description: Earliest SystemModstamp (or LastModifiedDate) read: an RFC 3339 time or YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC. Empty reads every record.
start_date.title: Start Date

streams_exclude.description: Object name patterns (path.Match syntax) left out after streams_include.
streams_exclude.title: Objects to exclude

streams_include.description: Object name patterns (path.Match syntax, such as Account or *__c); empty includes every queryable object.
streams_include.title: Objects to include

connectionSpecification.title: Salesforce Source Spec
